### CANDIDATE DETAIL
#### 1. pulmonary fibrosis and/or bone marrow failure, Telomere-related, 2  —  Tier 1 — Definitive / Highly Plausible  (fitness 0.786)
**Link type:** shared causal gene (HGNC:11727)

**Proposed mechanism:** TERC (HGNC:11727) —DISRUPTS→ Telomere maintenance (GO:0000798); Telomere maintenance (GO:0000798) —LEADS_TO→ Short telomeres (HP:0030175); Short telomeres (HP:0030175) —LEADS_TO→ Dyskeratosis congenita (MONDO:0007485); Short telomeres (HP:0030175) —LEADS_TO→ Pulmonary fibrosis (HP:0002211); Short telomeres (HP:0030175) —LEADS_TO→ Bone marrow failure (HP:0001884). Mutations in TERC impair telomere maintenance, leading to short telomeres which manifest as dyskeratosis congenita and pulmonary fibrosis/bone marrow failure.

**How to falsify it:** The identification of a common pathogenic variant in TERC with a population frequency >0.1% in gnomAD would falsify this hypothesis. _(variant: rs730881789)_

**Why it matters:** Understanding the shared mechanism of telomere attrition due to TERC mutations opens avenues for developing telomerase-activating therapies for both dyskeratosis congenita and telomere-related pulmonary fibrosis and bone marrow failure.
